payload.reason: The app's Agent Integrations settings are the installer Homebrew users actually have; they register the server as disk-steward through each client's CLI. The script registers disk_steward and copies the Codex plugin where Codex never loads it. One registration and the skill for both clients therefore have to come from the app's adapters, with the script made to agree.
